hypothesis_under_test: Fr → transition/resolution → continuation is structurally comparable to Ricci-flow singularity → surgery → continuation.

frustration.expression: Fr = necessity of continuation + impossibility of completing by the previous method

pre_transition.expression: P0 → P1 → P2 → P3 → P4 → Fr

scale_transition.expression: P4 → P5; Ck → Ck+1; Ck+1 != Ck; Ck+1 ≅ Ck

open_continuity.expression: local closure + interlevel openness = dynamic stability

ricci_side.core_structure: Ricci flow develops finite-time singular regions; surgery is a geometric procedure used to continue the flow past such singularities.
sources: Perelman, Ricci flow with surgery on three-manifolds, arXiv:math/0303109
AMS Notices survey on Ricci flow and surgery

supported_axes.myshko: previous geometric mode is exhausted while continuation remains required
supported_axes.ricci: smooth Ricci flow encounters a singular regime requiring a different continuation procedure

supported_axes.myshko: P4 → P5 is explicitly a transition to a new localization scale
supported_axes.ricci: surgery changes the geometric description at singular regions before continuation

supported_axes.myshko: process continues through P5 → P6 → P7 → P8 and interlevel openness
supported_axes.ricci: Ricci flow with surgery is constructed to continue beyond singularities

critical_mismatches: Myshko does not define a singular geometric quantity analogous to curvature blow-up.
Myshko does not define a surgery operator acting on a manifold or metric.
P4 → P5 is described as scale/localization transition, not cutting and capping a singular region.
No invariant-preserving correspondence between the two transition procedures is given.
No theorem or derivation maps the ontodynamic state space to Ricci-flow metrics.
The Planck scale is not derived from P4 → P5.

result.interpretation: The corpus confirms that the proposed structural comparison has a nontrivial source-side basis: frustration, exhausted continuation mode, regime/scale transition, and continued process are explicitly present. It does not confirm mathematical equivalence with Ricci-flow surgery.

next_tests: Define ontodynamic state space and transition operator.
Define the P4 → P5 operator independently of the Ricci analogy.
Identify what is preserved across P4 → P5.
Construct a candidate map from ontodynamic states to Ricci-flow geometric data.
Test whether the map preserves the relevant transition structure.
Only then investigate any characteristic scale, including but not assuming the Planck scale.
forbidden_inferences: P4 → P5 is already Ricci surgery
scale transition is equivalent to cutting and capping
Planck scale follows from the comparison
